entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in peak performance. Please say 'Sales' for new orders or 'Support' for existing orders.
Support.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support specialist now.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. My order number is VF8675309. It's the VeloBand Pulse.
Okay, I can definitely look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order... VF8675309. I see the VeloBand Pulse. And it looks like that was delivered to you 13 days ago, is that correct?
I guess. I don't know the exact day, but I have it and it's not what I wanted. I just want to send it back for a refund.

I understand. I do need to let you know, the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window due to the nature of the device. Since the delivery was 13 days ago, it looks like it's just outside that policy.

Are you kidding me? Ten days? That's ridiculous. I was out of town for a week. So because I didn't open your box the second it arrived, I'm stuck with a $150 piece of tech I don't want? I spend thousands with VeloFit!

I certainly understand your frustration, and I can see you're one of our top customers. I truly appreciate your loyalty. The problem is, the system automatically locks out returns for this specific item after 10 days.
So you're just going to read a script to me? This is unacceptable. I want to talk to a manager.

Please, hold on one moment. Look... my **manager would kill me** for even suggesting this, but let me see what I can do. Since you are a VIP customer, I might be able to manually **override the system**. I can't make any promises, but let me try.
Fine. Just fix it.
Okay, please hold for just a minute or two while I work on this. [short hold music fades in and out]
Thank you for your patience. I was able to get it to go through. I've processed the return authorization for you. Please consider this a special **one-time exception** to our policy.
Oh! Wow, really? So it's all set?

Yes, it is. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your full refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
That's... fantastic. Seriously, thank you so much, Alex. I was getting really frustrated there. You really helped me out.
It's my pleasure. We value your business with VeloFit and want to make sure you're taken care of. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's it. You saved the day. Thanks again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
